title: Microsoft Purview: bulk replacement or removal of retention labels (Worldwide)
summary: Hold: the description of manually changing record labels omits the requirement that SharePoint and OneDrive records be locked. The briefing also says the planned bulk action will encounter existing label rules while acknowledging that Microsoft has not documented whether those rules apply.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an administrator action in the Purview portal to replace or remove a retention label in bulk.
claims.quote: Admins can perform a bulk replacement or removal of a retention label using the Purview compliance portal.

claims.claim: Learn has no description of this planned tenant-wide or KQL/scoped bulk portal action as of November 2026.

claims.claim: Admins and end users can manually change or remove a standard retention label.
claims.quote: For standard retention labels (they don't mark items as a record or regulatory record): Admins and end users can manually change or remove an existing retention label that's applied on content.

claims.claim: An existing label is not automatically replaced except in the cases the retention page lists.
claims.quote: When items already have a retention label applied, the existing label won't be automatically removed or replaced by another retention label with the following exceptions:

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Labels that mark items as records can be changed or removed manually by container admins, without stating a record-lock requirement.
claims.quote: Manually remove | Yes | Yes ^1^ if admin for the container | No. Footnotes: ^1^ The record must be locked.
claims.fix: Replace the record-label clause in both sections with: 'For existing manual operations, only container admins can change or remove a record label; in SharePoint and OneDrive the record must be locked.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/records-management, which distinguishes locked and unlocked records and says Exchange maps to the locked-record column. Keep the separate statement that treatment by the planned bulk action is not documented.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Regulatory record labels cannot be changed or removed manually.
claims.quote: Only admins for the container can manually change or remove retention labels that mark items as a record, but can't manually change or remove retention labels that mark items as a regulatory record.

claims.claim: The documented existing label behaviour is behaviour any bulk action will meet.
claims.quote: Searched: '"bulk" "retention label" "replacement"'; 'Purview bulk retention label removal default enable tenant switch role restricted administrator audit scheduling preview undo auto apply'. Read retention and records-management pages; neither ties the planned bulk portal action to these rules.
claims.fix: Replace 'What Learn documents today is the label behaviour any bulk action will meet:' with 'For background, Learn documents existing label behaviour:'. Retain 'Whether bulk replacement follows those rules is not documented.'

claims.quote: Remove the retention label from a driveItem. This operation clears the retention label and all associated retention settings enforced on the item.
